product.name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8
product.notes: This is the wide, passport-shaped Fold8 (SM-F971x) announced at Unpacked on 2026-07-22, not the taller Fold8 Ultra (SM-F976x). Samsung's SG spec page gives 123.9 x 161.4 x 4.5 mm unfolded and 123.9 x 81.9 x 9.7 mm folded, and 201 g. Here w = 161.4 is the open width and l = 123.9 is the height. The battery is 4800 mAh typical, from two silicon-carbon cells totalling 18.68 Wh. The cell labels read 2393 and 2267 mAh (rated, about 4660 mAh). Inner display: 7.6 in, 4:3. Cover display: 5.5 in, 1972x1248, Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3. Rear cameras: 50 MP wide (OIS) and 50 MP ultrawide. Front: two 10 MP cameras. Other specs: aluminium frame, side fingerprint key, IP48, 45 W wired, 20 W wireless, 4.5 W reverse wireless. fold.gap = 9.7 - 2 x 4.5 = 0.7 mm. This assumes both halves are 4.5 mm and that the spec thickness excludes the camera bump. Folded width 81.9 is 1.2 mm more than half the open width (80.7), which is taken as the hinge spine's bulge. Layout convention: A is the back-glass/camera/main-board half (x 0..74.7), B is the cover-display half (x 86.7..161.4), and the hinge band is x 74.7..86.7. Seen from the back with the phone open, A is on the left. This matches the usual Fold layout, where the cover half swings to the left when opened as seen from the front. Every bbox is an estimate sized to the official outline. No source publishes internal coordinates. 'verified' means a source documents that the part exists and how it is fastened, not its coordinates.

sources.title: iFixit News - Galaxy Z Fold8 Teardown: Samsung's Best Foldable Still Has a Hinge Problem
sources.covers: Flex Titanium (Ti film + perforated Ti support plate under OLED); two Si-C cells on opposite halves, 18.68 Wh, pull jackets / easy-release adhesive; one cell only reachable through the outer display; back cover easy; outer display strong adhesive; plastic inner bezel broke; hinge + inner display = one service assembly; standard Phillips/JIS screws; USB-C on its own cable; main camera removal needs main board out and new thermal compound; provisional 4/10

sources.title: Notebookcheck - Galaxy Z Fold 8 earns disappointing rating in iFixit teardown
sources.covers: Reaching battery/camera requires removing the motherboard and re-applying thermal paste; outer display needs heavy heat and prying; modular USB-C

sources.title: GSMArena - Galaxy Z Fold8 does not impress in teardown (iFixit)

sources.title: Android Authority - The Galaxy Z Fold 8 just passed a bend test, but old weaknesses remain (JerryRigEverything)
sources.covers: Two titanium layers under the folding screen; inner screen and back cover heavily glued (heat + pry); pull-tab Si-C batteries; three core hinge elements (Fold7 had four); speakers and SIM tray with rubber seals; Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3 cover

sources.title: TechEBlog - Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 teardown (JerryRigEverything)
sources.covers: Battery labels 2393 and 2267 mAh; exterior spine plus three geared internal sections; 6 screws hold the sections and 18 keep the spine rigid; 56 screws in total; thermal paste + graphite pad, no vapour chamber; camera island is one replaceable plastic piece; 50 MP main with OIS, 50 MP ultrawide without; inner display layer order; coil on the back

sources.title: 9to5Google - Galaxy Z Fold 8's wider shape still survives bend test, teardown shows off titanium and poor Qi placement
sources.covers: Qi charging coil sits very low on the back; no Qi2 magnets; plastic top layer over the titanium-backed folding display

sources.title: Notebookcheck - Searching for Flex Titanium: the ultimate Galaxy Z Fold 8 teardown (JerryRigEverything)
sources.covers: Cover display and back panel removed first, then the hinge; hinge is several modular parts; glued flexible OLED; two pull-tab batteries

sources.title: Android Headlines - Galaxy Z Fold 8 teardown is here (JerryRigEverything)

sources.title: 9to5Google - Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 7 is as repair-unfriendly as you'd probably expect (iFixit Fold7)

sources.title: Phone Repair Guru - Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 teardown

steps.cautions: The OLED and its plastic bezel break easily. Never bend the panel off its support.
Seat both frames in one jig so the halves stay flat and in line.

steps.title_en: Hinge: plates, three gear sections, spine, 24 screws
steps.cautions: In service the hinge and inner display are one assembly. Keep dust and sand out of the hinge.
Leave the slack loop so the flex can follow the fold.

steps.title_en: Half A: sub board, motor, USB-C, bottom speaker
steps.cautions: Route the USB-C flex in its channel beside the battery.
Do not bend the cell. The thin Si-C pouches bend easily.

steps.title_en: Half A: thermal paste, main board, cameras
steps.cautions: Apply fresh thermal compound under the SoC. Snap in the battery, display, interconnect and camera connectors.

steps.title_en: Half A: main board bracket, graphite, lower bracket (16 screws)
Half A: wireless coil, back glass, camera island
steps.cautions: The coil sits low on the back. Clamp the glass while the adhesive cures.

steps.title_en: Half B: SIM board, SIM tray, antenna, battery B
steps.cautions: Seat the SIM tray seal. Do not bend the cell.

steps.title_en: Half B: board, cover camera, top speaker, bracket (13 screws)

steps.cautions: Plug the cover display flex into board B before you lay the glass down. The adhesive is very strong, so align it carefully.
